attribution: receipt-envelope-profile v0.1 R2 — a refusal needs a declaration, added 2026-09-25
rationale: The bundle carries no `schema` at all and is otherwise a sound eval receipt. It declares no other format, so there is nothing to refuse on its behalf, and our schema requires the field: `invalid`, fail-closed. An implementation that read a missing identifier as an unknown one would refuse here, and anything stripped of its identifier would then buy a refusal.
